benchmark: The NZ benchmark list (Red Rocks, Kapiti Island, Ninety Mile Beach, etc.) is not applicable to a Tasmanian region. Applicable checks pass: no operator or vehicle spots kept (Launceston Ghost Tour and the Tamar River cruises rejected); a once-a-week market (Harvest Market) rejected; a civic/occasion venue (York Park) rejected; gateway-village wrappers (Pyengana, Beauty Point, Beaconsfield, Low Head, Gladstone) rejected or folded; a long feature (Bay of Fires) is a destination reached at Binalong Bay and Eddystone Point, not a spot under a neighbour. Data fixes applied: Little Blue Lake and St Columba Falls coordinates in candidates.json belong to other places and are not used.
